newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET-Greatbatch joins NZ selection panel.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-Greatbatch joins NZ selection panel.

text.p: WELLINGTON, Oct 31 - Recalled batsman Mark Greatbatch will serve as a selector alongside coach Steve Rixon and captain Lee Germon on the New Zealand cricket team's tour of Sharjah and Pakistan, which begins next week.
Team manager Earle Cooper, making the announcement on Thursday, added that it had been decided not to name a vice-captain for the tour, NZPA reported.

"Greatbatch gives a good balance to the selection process. He is an experienced international player, respected senior member of the team, and brings his experience as captain of Central Districts to the selection process," Cooper said.
Cooper said a vice-captain had not been named because it was felt the duties of such a position should be covered collectively by the squad's senior players.
"The main responsibility of this person (the vice-captain) would be a tactical support to Lee Germon on the field," he said.
"However, after some consideration, it was decided that all the senior players had a role to play in this regard and that they would do so."
The New Zealand team, currently preparing for their tour in the northern Queensland resort town of Cairns, will play a 50-overs game against a Queensland Country 11 at Innisfail on Thursday.
They will leave for Sharjah, where they will play a triangular one-day tournament with Sri Lanka and Pakistan on Sunday.
